validated_successes.lesson: Pre-LayerNorm with direct residual shortcut prevents attention saturation during PPO.
Sigmoid FSR normalization prevents raw contact spikes from drowning proprioception.
Decoupled 6-Head specialty architecture allows independent sagittal/lateral balance.
10.01M Titan Transformer (6 blocks, 3 layers) achieves < 1.0 ms P99 latency on M4.

avoided_mistakes.mistake: Setting action_scale > 0.10 when resuming pre-trained weights causes joint flaring.
avoided_mistakes.mitigation: Strictly lock action_scale = 0.08 across all training and evaluation runs.

avoided_mistakes.mistake: Running < 60 iterations on 10M Transformer policy causes PPO gradient under-convergence.
avoided_mistakes.mitigation: Enforce minimum 80 iterations per evolutionary cycle.

avoided_mistakes.mistake: Narrow foot stance (y < 4 cm) leaves zero margin for ankle roll torque against kicks.
avoided_mistakes.mitigation: Dynamic arm flaring + hip roll pre-tension via decoupled lateral head.

persistent_weaknesses.action_plan: Incrementally scale perturb_prob from 0.065 to 0.080 and boost hip damping.
Reinforce spine pitch posture compliance during landing shock.
Tune fine learning rate (7e-5) with cosine annealing.
